Class Paired

java.lang.Object
education.the_software_toolsmith.testing.framework.tests.Paired
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Paired>
public final class Paired extends Object implements Comparable<Paired>
Utility class to facilitate testing if sort() is stable

Note: This class is immutable

Version:
1.0 2020-07-18 Initial implementation, 1.1 2021-07-30 Correct equals() to not consider id, 1.2 2021-11-16 Add identical() to facilitate stable sort check, 1.3 2023-04-05
  • update implementations of equals() and hashCode()
  • deprecate identical() since it can't evaluate to true
, 2.0 2025-02-26
  • remove deprecated identical()
  • rearrange result of toString()
Author:
Dave Rosenberg
